**Finding submitted: deviation (WARRANTY).**

- **Issue:** Article VIX puts the Licensed Technology wholly on an AS IS basis, disclaims all express and implied warranties, and expressly says nonconformity to the Documentation may never be corrected. No affirmative conformance or performance warranty exists elsewhere — Article VII only promises "commercially reasonable efforts" on Error Corrections, a support covenant with no repair/replace/refund remedy.
- **Classification:** Walk-away territory under the rule (AS IS with no conformance warranty), so it fails the 90-day/30-day fallback as well.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** carved the express warranties out of the disclaimer in p0110 and inserted a new Express Warranties paragraph after p0116 — 12-month Software/Documentation conformance, professional and workmanlike services, legal compliance, no malicious code, with re-performance/repair/replacement and a refund backstop if not cured in 30 days. Fallback of a 90-day software period offered in the comment.
